mathematical_scope: Finite, explicitly instantiated split state-transition profiles; full printed stage ordering is exercised.
Fraction arithmetic proves the listed discrete examples exactly; general conservation/invertibility proofs are algebraic in the document.
Rational BE pair/reaction/attenuation maps are first-order consistency schemes, not exact ODE or optical flows.
Exponential pair/reaction/attenuation formulas are exact individual real-arithmetic subflows; the coupled Lie composition is first order.
Rusanov Euler uses a direct CFL time schedule; positivity applies on its ideal-gas admissible state domain.
Floating conservation is measured by residuals; no claim of bitwise exact physical conservation is made.
Finite snapshots losslessly serialize rational state or an already rounded float64 state, not arbitrary mathematical real numbers.
Derived geometry outputs carry no extra stored mechanical energy; the oscillator's storage coefficients remain fixed.
These tests do not establish continuum convergence, arbitrary-material well-posedness, 3-D Navier-Stokes global regularity, or Einstein-field existence.
